items.title: Jito jumps 16% on Asian expansion news – Are JTO shorts in trouble?
items.whyYouShouldCare: Jito's expansion into Asia could enhance its market presence, potentially increasing demand for JTO and impacting liquidity dynamics in the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.whyYouShouldCare: The successful testing of Solana's 150-millisecond settlement upgrade could improve transaction efficiency, attracting more users and applications to the network.
